title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes and version bumps
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve parity and ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs for authentication, retry behavior, and streaming APIs. This PR consolidates the auth token refresh and retry policies into a shared spec, improves streaming consumer ergonomics (cancellable async iterators / callbacks parity), applies several small API surface parity fixes, and bumps SDK package versions to prepare for a coordinated release.

What this changes: consolidated retry backoff defaults, explicit retryable error mapping, standardize refresh-token flow to support both async and blocking use-cases, streaming API parity (Python async iterator + sync iterator helper, TS readable stream + async iterator, Go channel-based stream helper), updated docs and changelogs, and version bumps for python/typescript/go packages.

Checklist:
- [x] Define shared auth/retry spec (ENG-1234)
- [x] Implement shared logic in each SDK where appropriate
- [x] Add backwards-compatible ergonomic helpers for streaming
- [x] Update unit/integration tests for all three SDKs
- [x] Update changelogs and docs
- [x] Bump package versions and tag for coordinated release

Notes and caveats: Kept prior public convenience helpers but marked a few legacy helpers as deprecated with clear migration examples in the docs. There was one non-blocking lint failure in CI caused by an import ordering change in the TS SDK; fixed on the branch and re-ran CI. No breaking API changes to public call signatures were introduced; behavior changes are mostly additive or default-value adjustments to align across SDKs. Related Linear: ENG-1234, PM-9876. Related support ticket: SUP-402.
commits: python(sdk): implement unified retry/policy and streaming iterator helper
typescript(sdk): streaming iterator and retry adapter + tests
go(sdk): add channel-based streaming helper and retry adapter
docs: update streaming and auth guides
review_comments: Liam Chen: Left a couple small nits on the TS streaming API surface; suggested a small helper to convert ReadableStream to async iterator. Reply: addressed and added tests.

Maria Gomez: Asked for clarity on retry backoff and default values; requested doc updates and an explicit migration note. Reply: added doc section and left default values unchanged but documented behavior.
Ethan Park: Noted potential goroutine leak in early streaming implementation. Reply: fixed by using context cancellation in Go helper and added integration test to cover cancellation behavior.
QA: Verified cross-language example apps; reported one flake in typescript stream test which was fixed by adding a short stabilization delay in test harness.
release_notes: SDKs: Unified auth token refresh and retry semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go (ENG-1234).
SDKs: Improved streaming ergonomics — async iterator helpers and parity helpers across languages.
SDKs: Added helper utilities for retry backoff customization and standard retryable error mapping.
SDKs: Minor API parity fixes and documentation updates.
Packages: bumped python, typescript, and go SDK package versions for coordinated release.
